sentences.text: Could a clock ever lose a second instead of gaining one?
The IERS record of TAI minus UTC rises from 10 seconds in 1972 to 37 seconds now, in 27 one-second steps — every leap second has been added, and none has ever been taken away.

assertions.text: The IERS table of TAI-UTC lists 28 values from 10 s on 1 January 1972 to 37 s on 1 January 2017, each exactly one second larger than the one before: every one of the 27 steps added a second and none subtracted one.
